provenance.catalogue: Gaia DR3 astrometry/photometry + Bailer-Jones et al.2021 EDR3 geometric distances
provenance.credit: ESA/Gaia/DPAC; Bailer-Jones, Rybizki, Fouesneau, Demleitner and Andrae (2021); GAVO
provenance.query: SELECT TOP 50000 source_id,ra,dec,pmra,pmdec,parallax,parallax_error,phot_g_mean_mag,phot_bp_mean_mag,phot_rp_mean_mag,ruwe FROM gaia.dr3lite WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',83.78715182853901,-5.400382551151912,6.93671362500512)) AND phot_g_mean_mag<14 AND ruwe<1.4 AND parallax>5*parallax_error ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag,source_id

acquisitions.query: SELECT TOP 50000 source_id,ra,dec,pmra,pmdec,parallax,parallax_error,phot_g_mean_mag,phot_bp_mean_mag,phot_rp_mean_mag,ruwe FROM gaia.dr3lite WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',83.78715182853901,-5.400382551151912,6.93671362500512)) AND phot_g_mean_mag<14 AND ruwe<1.4 AND parallax>5*parallax_error ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag,source_id

provenance.selection: Authored spherical neighbourhood with radial taper. RUWE<1.4 and parallax/error>5; brightest TOP 50000 qualified Gaia cone candidates, then exact source-id Bailer-Jones lookups and local physical-sphere filtering. A reached candidate cap limits completeness. Distance medians and 16/84 percentiles retained; no cluster membership inferred.
